acdd-evidence-route.mjs.evidence: Owner-authenticated route for the evidence view.

acdd-evidence.mjs.evidence: Read-only ACDD evidence view (contracts, verifier records, acceptance) — campaign evidence display; never decides acceptance.

agent-context.mjs.evidence: Per-request workspace context assembly incl. docs/AGENT_GUIDE.md; 398 LOC, no dedicated test (note).

agent-discovery.mjs.evidence: Hermes/Grok/Pi backend discovery at boot (zero-agents boot supported).

agent-gateways.mjs.evidence: Gateway transport adapters for agents and shared rooms.

agent-profiles.mjs.evidence: Profile model shared by chat, context and workbench selection.

agent-providers.mjs.evidence: Provider model/registration used by agent, context, gateways, onboarding.

agent-session-controls.mjs.evidence: stop/steer/approval session controls shared by agent + gateway chat.

agent-status.mjs.evidence: Live agent status projection for /api/agent-status and the app.

agent.mjs.evidence: The agent bridge: authenticated runs, history, approvals, stop/steer, activity, capabilities, catalog, jobs; wires gateway chat + shared rooms + workbench binding.

automation.mjs.evidence: Hermes scheduled-job CRUD wrapper with explicit confirmation (pause/resume).

build-queue.mjs.evidence: Legacy build-queue lane: pinned disabled at boot; its unknown-outcome snapshot feeds workbench-gate fencing until legacy migration completes.

builtin-apps.mjs.evidence: Installs built-in app bundles (grokbots) into the runtime before bundle-index refresh; part of catalog+app serving.

bundle-registry.mjs.evidence: Content-addressed bundle index; exact-byte serving verification; protects published apps incl. the Observatory bundle.

colab-job-worker.mjs.evidence: Detached CLI step worker process (spawned by the orchestrator).

colab-orchestrator.mjs.evidence: Google Colab runtime orchestration (872 LOC): runtime list, step execution via detached job worker. Extraction: standalone service; Orbit keeps only the surface link.

collab-board.mjs.evidence: Loopback board poster for ~/bin/collab-board (system posters); operator tooling glue.

collab-orchestrator.mjs.evidence: Subagent spawn/limits/cost projection + span records (231 LOC): extractable as a standalone orchestrator service against the same board API.

collab.mjs.evidence: Orbit Collab: board, approvals (shell.write/review verdicts), orchestrator engine, budget gates — the operator approval flow for multi-agent work (2,081 LOC, 7 test refs).
collab.mjs.route: /api/irc? no — collab surface via host-surfaces + agent APIs

command-identity.mjs.evidence: Canonical request hashing/identity used by 54 modules incl. the store and every owner route.

conversation-private-store.mjs.evidence: Private fsynced conversation library store (never enters workspace DB).

extension-studio.mjs.evidence: Exact-artifact Studio: finite generator, drafts/checks/proposals, revocation receipts.

feature-readiness.mjs.evidence: Capability-readiness observation consumed by featureCapabilities and the settings UI; stat-only.

gateway-chat.mjs.evidence: Streaming chat runtime over the discovered/configured gateways (1,119 LOC).

grokbots-activity.mjs.evidence: Shared activity/redaction projection consumed by grokbots-app, agent-status and acdd-evidence (load-bearing across families).

grokbots-app.mjs.evidence: Grok Bots app backend: capability-scoped list/history/send/upload for the sandboxed app + launch capability. Load-bearing today (built-in app); extraction target: standalone agent-chat app service.

grokbots-controls-grok.mjs.evidence: Grok gateway controls for the app (bridges to the external sand-host gateway).

grokbots-groups.mjs.evidence: Group rooms over the shared-agents engine for the app.

host-audit.mjs.evidence: Hash-chained per-host audit log used by the hosts UI and permission changes.

host-recipes.mjs.evidence: Idempotent worker-install recipes: unreachable from index.mjs, imported only by host-api.mjs and its test (dead with host-api).

index.mjs.evidence: Composition root: every route, the PTY websocket, auth env and shutdown; the single place all server families are wired.

knowledge-index.mjs.evidence: Source-backed keyword + optional semantic search service (lazy-mounted /api/search).

local-host.mjs.evidence: node-pty LocalHostProvider + tmux history capture for /api/terminal and pane history.

local-workers.mjs.evidence: Cua/OpenCode workers on a tailnet PC; off unless ORBIT_LOCAL_WORKERS=1. Extraction: standalone worker-fleet service.

managed-terminal-broker.mjs.evidence: Owner-scoped broker binding terminals to workspaces; journal-backed.

managed-terminal-contract.mjs.evidence: Shared contract shapes for the managed-terminal family.

managed-terminal-ledger.mjs.evidence: Durable private identity ledger for adopted tmux shells; gates the legacy attach fallback.

managed-terminal-provider.mjs.evidence: Attach-only tmux lifecycle (adopt existing shells); private fresh-session mode.

onboarding-apply.mjs.evidence: Applies reviewed onboarding/Settings changes to orbit-config.json.

onboarding-wiring.mjs.evidence: Glue for /api/onboarding, /api/settings, /api/hosts: config, onboarding, router, setup agent, ssh hosts, audit, OpenAI-compat gateway.

onboarding.mjs.evidence: Onboarding wizard state machine (37 test refs).

openai-compat-gateway.mjs.evidence: Generic OpenAI-compatible/provider gateway for configured roles (openrouter/anthropic/router).

opencode-detect.mjs.evidence: Detects an available OpenCode binary for setup.

orbit-config.mjs.evidence: orbit-config.json schema, roles, agent profiles; zero-agents boot.

output-library.mjs.evidence: Outputs library: published files with private aliases/pins/tags (the Outputs surface).

pi-gateway.mjs.evidence: Hosts the Pi harness as a loopback gateway inside the Orbit process (901 LOC). Extraction: standalone gateway process with the same profile contract; Orbit only discovers an apiUrl.

pi-rpc.mjs.evidence: Pi RPC framing; travels with pi-gateway.

resource-delegation.mjs.evidence: Normal resource authority: grants pinned to accepted submissions; orbit_resources describe/grant flow (the owner approval surface for agent capabilities).

router-render.mjs.evidence: Router config rendering; travels with router-supervisor.

router-supervisor.mjs.evidence: Opt-in Docker token router supervisor (bifrost/litellm, pinned digests); off unless router.enabled. Extraction: standalone compose profile + CLI; Orbit keeps only config UI.

run-trace-tee.mjs.evidence: In-process tee of agent run streams into /api/run-traces.

run-traces-route.mjs.evidence: Unwired duplicate route: /api/run-traces is served through technologyOwnerRoute; this handler is imported only by tests/run-traces.test.mjs.

security.mjs.evidence: Owner token/origin validation used by 21 server modules; the owner-auth primitive.

shared-agents.mjs.evidence: Shared-room engine (1,266 LOC) behind normal chat handoff and the grokbots groups app.

shared-chats.mjs.evidence: Private per-pane chat persistence for the conversation library.

sqlite-workspace-store.mjs.evidence: Transactional state authority (schema 12): revisions, checkpoints, receipts, outbox, bundles, workbench/project-tools records. 54 consumers.

ssh-hosts.mjs.evidence: Direct SSH host registry/pinning behind /api/hosts (owner UI); roadmap "later" feature but load-bearing for the hosts settings surface.

static-cache.mjs.evidence: Immutable content-hashed asset serving for the built client.

technology-assets.mjs.evidence: Serves /vendor/* local engine assets (duckdb, voice, fonts) for browser-side surfaces; travels with the surfaces as an asset service.

technology-owner-route.mjs.evidence: The extraction seam itself: owner-authenticated POST dispatch wrapper every lazy technology service mounts behind.

terminal-resource-registry.mjs.evidence: Process-local terminal identity registry used by the broker (fencing primitive).

voice-model-assets.mjs.evidence: Voice model manifest/integrity pins for the dictation surface.

workspace-description.mjs.evidence: Bounded layout metadata + operation catalog for the workspace controller.

workspace-events.mjs.evidence: Authenticated bounded POST event pages (polling, not SSE).

workspace.mjs.evidence: Authenticated workspace/control/recovery service + /apps/* serving; supplies workspaceRead to every family.

apps.evidence: Deployed Observatory: static catalog-admissible viewer for rizzstack.observability/snapshot/1 (fleet, usage, pipeline, backlog, health, alerts). Source in extensions/rizzstack-observatory; registration documented in its README; PROTECTED by owner directive — never modified or retired by this decomposition.
Built-in multi-agent chat app, installed into the runtime at boot by server/builtin-apps.mjs and served content-addressed; backed by /api/grokbots-app family. Operator-facing multi-agent chat.
Live tool-call viewer embedded in Activity panes; src/tool-feed.ts posts orbit:tool-feed events to its published bundle URLs. Ported deliberately per CORPUS_TRIAGE bucket 3.

Static token-telemetry viewer; scripts/token_widget_export.py (operator-host script reading the Hermes state DB) writes usage.json beside the deployed copy. Load-bearing on the deployed host, but its export script carries a hardcoded personal DB path — extraction candidate for owner tooling.
